name: What types of outdoor handrails are available for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of outdoor handrails are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common outdoor handrail materials include aluminum, steel, wrought iron, and composite. Aluminum is popular for its low maintenance and rust resistance. Steel offers strength and durability, often with a powder-coated finish for protection. Wrought iron provides a classic, decorative look but requires more maintenance to prevent rust. Composite materials are gaining popularity for their wood-like appearance without the need for painting or staining, offering good weather resistance. Each material has distinct aesthetic and functional properties to suit different architectural styles and budget requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Outdoor handrails are commonly made from aluminum, steel, wrought iron, or composite materials, each offering different aesthetics, durability, and maintenance needs.
